regressions.failure: The deck moves directly from its title slide into the first body topic.
regressions.expected: The first content slide gives a concise, non-corny executive summary of the complete video before the body begins.

regressions.failure: A screenshot is timestamp-linked and topically related but does not visibly show the feature named by the slide.
regressions.expected: A retained screenshot clearly shows the object, feature, state, or demonstration claimed by the slide; otherwise use a different frame or an evidence-backed editable diagram.
